text.zh: 大軍何能為，我當飲墮瑰門下矣！
text.en: What can the great army do? I shall drink beneath the Duigui Gate!

In Tonghe year 12, because the Mei, Duigui, and Zheli three divisions had few registered households, the court combined them into one division.
In Tonghe year 12, because the Meizhi, Duigui, and Aoli three divisions had few registered households, the court combined them into one division.
Under the 奧裏部 heading, 以與梅只，墮瑰三部 means Aoli together with Meizhi and Duigui; Zheli is invented and Mei truncates 梅只. Parallel 聖宗合奧裏、梅只、墮瑰三部為一 confirms the three names.
The Garrisoning the Wugu Wug Division.
戍隗烏古部 is the Garrisoning Wei Wugu division; 'The Garrisoning the Wugu Wug' is ungrammatical and misreads 隗 as a repeated Wugu.
